output_scope: Only this performance-analysis.json is authored by this audit; source logs, samples, manifests and TRX files are read-only inputs.

method.experimental_unit: Fresh process. Each side has four processes per scenario and order; 24 operations within a process are correlated measurements, not 24 independent experimental replicates.
method.workload: 10000 rows,8 columns; alternating source swaps or ScrollIntoView row5000/row0, followed by dispatcher jobs and UpdateLayout.
method.allocation_unit: Managed bytes allocated on the current UI thread/operation

formulae.process_mean: Exact rational arithmetic mean of all 24 retained decimal operations; serialized as a floating-point value.
formulae.overall_mean: Arithmetic mean of four process means per side.
formulae.balanced_block: Within chronological process positions0..3 and4..7, mean the two A process means and the two B process means separately.
formulae.delta: B mean minus A mean; percent =100*(B-A)/A.
formulae.parity: Compute even or odd sample mean inside each process, then mean the four process means per side; these are exploratory correlated directional diagnostics.
formulae.summary_comparison_tolerance: math.isclose(rel_tol=1e-12,abs_tol=1e-9) validates floating serialization only; this is not a performance or allocation acceptance allowance.

method.selection: All completed requested local comparisons and downloaded CI comparisons retained. No time sample, process, order, block or parity direction excluded.
method.threshold_policy: No percentage/byte tolerance, p-value gate or automatic acceptance verdict is applied.
method.runner_setup_deviation: Local prepared-runner setup uses externally indexed worktrees and injects the unchanged C# harness before building; timed command/order are preserved. Local reverse and A/A repeat processes reuse recorded identical binaries. CI artifacts use the immutable runner, which builds separate worktrees for each comparison.
method.immutability_scope: Local/CI harness equality and binary reuse are based on captured manifests/hashes. Product worktrees and binaries were not reopened or rebuilt by this dataset audit.

not_recorded: actual scroll offsets at operation boundaries
viewport or presenter geometry after each operation
number of layout passes or dispatcher jobs
recycled/created row and cell counts per operation
metadata_coverage.consequence: Matched captured metadata does not prove equal realized layout work. The unchanged harness requests rows5000/0 but does not log actual offsets or exact realized counts. Additional diagnostics must be separately attributed and must not replace the uninstrumented raw timing runs.

limitations: Finite process samples cannot establish universal zero regression or prove exact equality.
A/A dispersion demonstrates that differences can arise without a source change; it neither licenses a numerical allowance nor dismisses repeated positive candidate estimates.
No source workload increase is offset against a scroll improvement, and no timing improvement offsets added allocation.
Parity splits are exploratory and state-dependent; consistent direction is evidence to investigate, not an independently randomized causal comparison.
Headless JIT managed/layout measurements do not establish native compositor/GPU performance or NativeAOT performance.
Current-thread allocated bytes exclude background-thread/native allocations and do not measure retained memory, peak working set or universal memory behavior.
Hosted CI runs use different hardware/OS environments and independently rebuilt worktrees. Results are reported per platform; no cross-platform average is used.
Local manifests record environment overrides as empty dictionaries; this does not certify that all inherited environment, power, thermal or background activity was controlled.
Original maintainer macOS measurements used SDK 10.0.201/runtime 10.0.5; this SDK 10.0.403/runtime 10.0.14 evidence has a different environment and are not interchangeable replicas.

Each initial full-validation CI strict native gate failed an overbroad warning validator and did not execute its binary. Separate native-only follow-ups now verify native execution for both exact sources on all three OSes; the earlier Not run records are preserved.
Missing final-platform artifacts remain unaudited until downloaded; another platform or an earlier revision does not verify them.

Final macOS full-suite execution was 6019 total/executed,6018 passed and1 failed. The retained failure is a NullReferenceException in HeadlessUnitTestSession.Dispose during DataGrid_ColumnDefinitionsSource_DoesNotLeak; its cause is not established here.
Actual scroll offsets and exact realized row/cell counts are not present in the uninstrumented harness output; requested target rows and matching metadata do not establish equal realized layout work.

Any claim of native execution must cite a separate observed native-run result for that exact revision and platform.
Do not state that all performance/allocation regressions are ruled out or that the strict maintainer gate has automatically been satisfied.
Retain the final macOS6018 passed/1failed headless-session disposal failure. A successful native-only follow-up does not convert that earlier full-suite result into a pass.
